objective: Execute DPL-03 — Research, Study, Discovery & Experimentation Loop. Define a reusable question/hypothesis → plan → research/experiment → evidence/result → contradiction/failure/partial success → discovery → application/publication loop usable by science, magic, archaeology and engineering while preserving provenance, hidden-knowledge controls and existing owner-domain truth.

acceptance_profile.research_loop: Represent question/hypothesis, governed plan, research/experiment activity references, evidence/result references, contradiction/failure/partial-success outcomes, discovery and application/publication handoffs without creating a parallel Project or Character ledger.
acceptance_profile.provenance: Every evidence/result/discovery assertion retains explicit source/provenance and setting/profile scope; unresolved or contradictory evidence remains explicit rather than silently resolved.
acceptance_profile.hidden_knowledge: Visibility/reveal authorization is applied before search/projection/publication so hidden knowledge or source-profile facts are not leaked or universalized.
acceptance_profile.owner_boundaries: Use DPL-02 profession/activity profiles, APW/D26 Projects/time, Character/Progression capability references, MIB-12 transformations, MIB-14 facilities and existing MSS/World/GM owners by reference rather than replacing them.
acceptance_profile.cross_domain: One research-loop contract must be usable across scientific, magical, archaeological and engineering contexts without collapsing science into magic or inventing universal formulas.
acceptance_profile.boundaries: No DPL-04+ chemistry/medicine/extraction/industry/business mechanics, no duplicate knowledge/Project/progression ledgers, no real-money commerce and no migration 0022 without demonstrated durable schema delta.
acceptance_profile.validation: Focused DPL-03 verifier plus exact-head repository health and governed Linux/Windows deterministic Validation Core must pass before merge.

nonauthorization: DPL-03 implementation before next owner Continue governed-starts it
automatic discovery or publication that bypasses source/provenance, visibility, GM or setting authority
silent science-to-magic collapse or inferred universal research formulas
migration 0022 without demonstrated durable schema delta
next_action: Next owner Continue governed-starts DPL-03 only from current canonical AIOC/application main; selection alone grants no implementation authority.
